To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the single c-domain PZT thin films exhibit high piezoeletric constants with low permittance.
the single crystal/single domain PZT-based perovskite films with high piezocoupling and low permittivity have been successfully fabricated.
single c-domain/single-crystal Pb(Mn,Ni)-PZT thin films exhibit high piezoeletric constants with low dielectrics constants.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following issues: (1) to develop a novel process for the single c-domain PZT-based perovskite thin film; (2) to investigate the dielectric and piezo properties of the single crystal PZT thin films in relation to the crystal structure, and the crystal structure in relation to the process conditions; (3) to investigate the origin of the low dielectric constant and high piezoelectrics of the single crystal thin films in relation with the crystal structure;
the synthesis of high performance piezoelectric and ferroelectric materials, including the single c-domain/ single crystal PZT thin films and the PZT thin film composites.
the development of high coupling and/or piezoelectric constant with low permittivitiy thin films of PZT-based perovskite ternary system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the low dielectric constant of single c-domain PZT is due to a large number of 180° domains in PZT-based bulk ceramics.
the low dielectric constant of the single c-domains is due to the absence of the domain walls.
the single c-domain structure is responsible for the high coupling and/or piezoelectric coefficients with low dielectric constant of the single c- domain single crystal thin films.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the single c-domain single crystal thin films of Pb(Mn,Ni)PZT are promising candidates for piezoelectric applications, such as piezoelectric EH-MEMS.
the single c-domain structure of the single crystal thin film is the origin of the high coupling and/or the high piezoelectrics with the low dielectric constants.
the low dielectric constants of the single c-domains/single crystal PZTs are attributed to the high degree of the domain alignment.
The main takeaway from our work is that

single c-domain/single-crystal PZT-based perovskite thin films can be used to fabricate piezoelectric EH devices, and the EH devices will be more efficient than the conventional PZT-based devices due to the low dielectric constants.
the single c-domain single crystal thin films have the potential of being used as the piezoelectrics in EH-MEMS.
the single crystal thin films with single c-domain structure exhibit low dielectric constants with high piezocoupling, i.e., high e31,f with low ε* values.
